citations.quote: After the extended period, applications and submissions of investment products administered by the Investment Products Division (IPD)1 must be submitted to IPD via e-IP from 30 November 2024.

This circular informs the industry that the Securities and Futures Commission (SFC) will extend the parallel run period of its new online application/submission system for investment products, e-IP, by one month to 29 November 2024.

The current submission requests from IPD via the IP E-submission system will be integrated into e-IP, including reporting of net asset values, large redemptions and suspensions of dealing. In addition, e-IP users can also settle recurring annual fees associated with relevant investment products through the new system.

1 Investment-linked assurance schemes, mandatory provident fund products, open-ended fund companies, paper gold schemes, pooled retirement funds, real estate investment trusts, unit trusts and mutual funds and unlisted structured investment products.

reading.distinction: Product administration, individual submission events and fee payments are separate classifications. The mandatory route attaches to applications and submissions, including the described reporting submissions; the statement that users can also pay recurring annual fees does not itself impose a mandatory payment channel. Each submission is assessed separately at its submission date. This result determines only compliance with the stated submission route, and confers no authorisation, licence or broader legal approval.

reading.statement: [TRUE_IS_COMPLIANT] For an individual application or submission concerning an IPD-administered investment product made on or after 2024-11-30, the result answers whether it complied with the stated mandatory e-IP route: true means it was submitted through e-IP; false means it was not. Outside that scope, no compliance conclusion is made. Unknown facts remain unknown.
